items.name: Pinterest Red
items.role: the brand's only highly-saturated color. Sign-up CTAs, sticky top-nav anchor, active state in tab strips, and the brand wordmark.

items.name: Pinterest Red Pressed
items.role: pressed state for the primary button — a single notch deeper than brand red.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: true white. The base surface for the primary nav, modals, feature cards, and content body.

items.name: Soft Surface
items.role: faintly cream-tinted off-white used for the page body wash on the home page hero.

items.name: Surface Card
items.role: warm-cream card and pin-tile background. Carries category tiles, search-bar default fill, button-secondary default, and pin-card backgrounds.

items.name: Secondary BG
items.role: the gray-cream used for ("I already have an account") fill — a notch deeper than .

items.name: Secondary Pressed
items.role: pressed state for the secondary button.

items.name: Surface Dark
items.role: warm near-black used in the rare dark CTA strip on create.pinterest.com.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: 1px row dividers, footer column rules.

items.name: Hairline Soft
items.role: lighter inline divider; doubles as the secondary-button background.

items.name: Ink
items.role: primary headlines, button text, primary nav links.

items.name: Ink Soft
items.role: inline-link color in body prose. The brand's only "color" beyond Pinterest Red used in chrome — a near-black with a faint warm cast.

items.name: Body
items.role: default paragraph text on .

items.name: Mute
items.role: metadata text, footer links, secondary captions.

items.name: Ash
items.role: disabled button text, placeholder text in inputs.

items.role: least-emphasis utility text, disabled-state borders.

items.name: On Dark
items.role: primary text on .

items.role: validation messages, destructive confirmation copy.
